acceptance: The pyspark-df shard runs on a supported JDK and its cells get past data loading.
Every workflow that starts Spark pins the JDK instead of relying on the runner default.
context:
Evidence: release-v2 run 40971306663 (tag v0.5.0rc2, commit b1459438d), artifact release-uat-v0.5.0rc2-stage1-pyspark-df: cells.jsonl, uat_gate_summary.json, validator_rollup.tsv, uat_lifecycle.log and per-cell logs. The artifacts do not keep result JSON, so query-level causes need a local rerun of the named cells. The three pyspark-df write_primitives cells reached the query phase and failed with query_failure; recheck them after the JDK fix.

Hosted trunk UAT run https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/BenchBox/actions/runs/42536258036 completed with failure at source 2d796acd59be06ab4b4a1742dda84cff419202b9. Spark SQL: all 43 selected cells passed; PySpark DataFrame: all 39 selected cells passed. The current selected Spark workloads ran on the real hosted runner rather than only unit fixtures. Counts cover the selected current matrix only; no historical issue is closed by this note. The full run is still red (702/710 passed), so this is not release certification.

Review 2026-11-11: line 1 met (PR #3750 pins Temurin 21 in release-uat-env; trunk UAT 42718296767: pyspark-df 39/39, spark 43/43). Line 2 not met literally: ci.yml, trunk.yml and nightly-v2.yml set no JDK; their local-Spark unit tests skip on incompatible Java instead of running. Remaining: add setup-java 21 to those workflows, or get the owner to narrow line 2 to UAT workflows.

Revalidated 2026-11-11 (develop c7b75c80bc): line 1 of the acceptance is met and stays met: .github/actions/release-uat-env/action.yml:46-49 pins actions/setup-java to Temurin 21 and is used by every shard job in release-v2.yml and trunk-uat.yml. Trunk UAT run 42718296767 and the scheduled runs 42789483182 (2026-11-10) and 42990393684 (2026-11-11, attempt 1) all concluded success, with the spark and pyspark-df shards in the matrix (trunk-uat.yml:116,126). Line 2 is still not met: git grep for setup-java/java-version finds it only in release-uat-env, so ci.yml, trunk.yml, nightly-v2.yml and release-canary.yml still rely on the runner default Java, and tests/unit/platforms/dataframe/test_pyspark_unified_frame_ops.py:16-24 skips when Java is incompatible rather than failing. Remaining scope is only that hygiene change (add setup-java 21 to the workflows that run Spark-backed tests, or owner narrows line 2 to the UAT workflows). Priority lowered critical -> medium: the release-UAT failure this item was filed for is fixed and verified on hosted runs; the remainder silently skips a few local-Spark tests.

Owner decision 2026-11-11 (choice dialog): pin Java 21 (actions/setup-java, Temurin 21) in ci.yml, trunk.yml and nightly-v2.yml so local Spark tests run instead of skipping; priority medium.
description: ubuntu-latest now defaults to Java 25. In the pyspark-df shard 43 of 45 cells failed with 'Detected Java 25. PySpark 4.x is not compatible with Java 23 or newer.' The Spark SQL shard ran on the same Java with 'restricted mode' warnings. Pin a supported JDK (17 or 21) with actions/setup-java for every Spark-family shard (spark, pyspark-df, lakesail if it needs one) in .github/actions/release-uat-env, and check the nightly and CI workflows for the same exposure.
